verdict.rationale: Privacy posture, including AI-training use of streamed content, is a fair question for a relay/CDN product that carries user media. However, the evidence contains no AI-training policy, opt-out, or data-use commitment. Self-hosting and end-to-end encryption are adjacent privacy controls, not a documented guarantee against training use, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
